question: When candidate evidence actions have stochastic outcomes, which action is most informative depends on whether the inferential target is the joint ecology-observation world or only the ecological-world projection.

candidate_actions.support_rule: k has positive Binomial probability under the joint world's ecological target state and observation world

metrics.guaranteed_joint_pair_splits: Number of active joint-world pairs whose possible outcome supports are disjoint.
metrics.worst_case_joint_survivors: Maximum number of active joint worlds compatible with any possible action outcome.
metrics.worst_case_ecological_survivors: Maximum number of distinct ecological worlds in the projection after any possible action outcome.

hypotheses.claim: Two joint worlds are guaranteed to be separated by an action if and only if their possible outcome supports are disjoint.
hypotheses.rule: Any mismatch between support intersection and guaranteed-pair classification refutes S1.

hypotheses.claim: In the frozen 112-world state, repeat_4_same_protocol has 0 guaranteed joint-pair splits and worst cases 112 joint / 64 ecological; calibration has 3072 splits and worst cases 64 joint / 64 ecological; gold-standard state has 1536 splits and worst cases 96 joint / 48 ecological.
Calibration is the unique best action under worst-case joint-world survivor count, while gold-standard state measurement is the unique best action under worst-case ecological-world survivor count.
hypotheses.rule: Any tie or different winner refutes S3.

hypotheses.claim: repeat_4_same_protocol is no better than both alternatives on guaranteed pair splits and both worst-case survivor metrics, and strictly worse on at least one metric against each alternative.
hypotheses.rule: Failure of this Pareto-dominance relation refutes S4.

boundary: These are robust support-based criteria, not expected utilities.
No prior probability over joint worlds is assumed.
Calibration and gold-standard assays are idealized evidence channels.
The planner may return different best actions for different inferential targets.
